thesis: David Blood argues that his initial disillusionment with corporate finance at E.F. Hutton was due to a lack of teamwork and client interaction rather than a dislike for finance itself. He subsequently analyzed the cultures of major investment banks and concluded that Goldman Sachs was the organization most aligned with his values regarding how people work and teamwork.
